biome_types.description: Mixed deciduous and coniferous forest in temperate climate.
Forest with active fey ecology and magical living systems. The Feywood is the canonical example.
Volcanic mountain regions with active or dormant vents. Source of forge metals, sulfur, obsidian.
Marsh, swamp, riparian, and bog systems. Source of certain herbs, reeds, peat.
Subterranean cave systems beyond surface ecology. Source of crystal, deep ores, and resonance materials.
Open plains, savanna, prairie. Source of grain, fiber, and grazing-derived materials.
Shoreline, intertidal, and salt-influenced ecosystems. Source of salt, kelp, certain shells.
Threshold zones where fey influence is unstable or partial. Material properties may shift.
Sites of pre-Cataclysm civilization where worked materials and artifacts may persist.
Areas where celestial fragments fell during the Cataclysm. Source of recovered celestial metal.
Cultivated, husbanded, or otherwise produced through settled labor. Source of farmed and ranched materials.
